# appearance.json

> 原始文件: `appearance.json`  |  类型: `.json`  |  自动转换

```json
{
  "accentColor": "#7f6df2",
  "cssTheme": "",
  "baseFontSize": 16,
  "baseFontSizeAction": true,
  "enabledCssSnippets": [],
  "theme": "obsidian",
  "translucency": false,
  "nativeMenus": true,
  "showViewHeader": true,
  "interfaceFontFamily": "Microsoft YaHei",
  "textFontFamily": "Microsoft YaHei",
  "monospaceFontFamily": "Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace",
  "showRibbon": true
}

```
